description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin exposing the official DeepSeek Tool APIs as three model-facing tools: OCR (PDF, Word, PowerPoint and images to page-marked Markdown), web search, and page fetch. Billed by DeepSeek per successful page or request; requires a DeepSeek API key or a DeepSeek account sign-in. MIT.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地 bundle 插件：把 DeepSeek 官方 Tool API 封装为 OCR（PDF、Word、PowerPoint、图片，按页输出 Markdown）、联网搜索、网页抓取三个模型工具；按成功页数或请求数计费，需要 DeepSeek API Key 或 DeepSeek 账号登录。MIT。
